strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Enter at the price level of the candle that made the liquidity grab after price breaks support or resistance and reverses: go long at the top of the candle that swept support, or go short at the bottom of the candle that swept resistance.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity grab wick/level, and take profit at a recent swing level in the opposite direction: recent high for longs, recent low for shorts.

variants.timeframe_note: Works on all time frames; examples shown on mixed charts
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: No extra confirmation beyond identifying the liquidity-grab candle/entry signal
variants.target_note: Take profit at the nearest/recent swing high or swing low
variants.transcript_quote: you would enter here set your stop loss right right below the liquidity grab and you're going to set your take profit at a recent high

variants.timeframe_note: Lower-timeframe entry aligned with higher-timeframe support/resistance; example uses 15-minute and 1-hour
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Prefer setups where peaks are closer than 10 candles apart, add momentum divergence, and only take signals occurring at/
variants.target_note: Normal stop loss and take profit rules still apply
variants.transcript_quote: we move back to the 15-minute time frame and do our normal stop loss and take profit

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches one runnable liquidity-grab reversal skeleton; the 10-candle rule, divergence, and higher-timeframe support/resistance are presented as confluences/filter variants, not separate strategies with different exit logic.
